{{further|2026 Cincinnati Open}}

[[Coco Gauff]] defeated [[Jessica Pegula]] in the final, 6–2, 6–4 to win the women's singles tennis title at the [[2026 Cincinnati Open]]. It was her second title at the [[Cincinnati Open]] (after [[2023 Western & Southern Open – Women's singles|2023]]), fourth [[WTA 1000 tournaments|WTA 1000]] title and twelfth career [[WTA Tour]] title overall. She became only the third woman in the [[History of tennis#Open Era|Open Era]] to win multiple Cincinnati Open singles titles, after [[Serena Williams]] and [[Victoria Azarenka]]. This was the first all-American women's singles final at the tournament since [[1970 Western Championships|1970]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.wtatennis.com/videos/4565389/gauff-races-to-second-cincinnati-crown-against-pegula|title=Gauff takes down Pegula to become two-time Cincinnati champion|website=wtatennis.com|accessdate=23 August 2026}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.wtatennis.com/news/4565399/gauff-joins-serena-azarenka-as-two-time-cincinnati-champion|title=After 'a long journey,' Gauff joins exclusive club with second Cincinnati title|website=wtatennis.com|accessdate=23 August 2026}}</ref>

[[Iga Świątek]] was the defending champion,<ref>{{cite web|url=https://apnews.com/article/cincinnati-open-swiatek-paolini-06f3bd2d83411f2f9f6ecd6d13be0faf|title=Iga Swiatek wins Cincinnati Open title, defeats Jasmine Paolini|publisher=Associated Press|accessdate=19 August 2025}}</ref> but lost in the semifinals to Pegula.

[[Aryna Sabalenka]] retained the [[List of WTA number 1 ranked singles tennis players|WTA No. 1 singles ranking]] after [[Elena Rybakina]] retired in the quarterfinals.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.wtatennis.com/news/4559575/rankings-watch-swiatek-returns-to-top-5-rybakina-narrows-gap-to-no-1|title=Rankings Watch: Swiatek returns to Top 5, Rybakina narrows gap to No. 1|website=wtatennis.com|accessdate=14 August 2026}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.wtatennis.com/news/4563969/swiatek-reaches-cincinnati-semifinals-as-rybakina-succumbs-to-left-ankle-injury|title=Swiatek reaches Cincinnati semifinals as Rybakina succumbs to left ankle injury|website=wtatennis.com|accessdate=20 August 2026}}</ref>
